name: Multiculturalism
overview: Scripture reveals that God calls His people to live distinctively from the surrounding nations by following His ordinances and statutes rather than adopting the customs of the heathen around them, as seen in Ezekiel's rebuke for walking after the manners of neighboring peoples and polluting His Sabbaths. At the same time, the Psalms invite all nations to praise the LORD, indicating God's desire for worship that transcends ethnic boundaries. The Old Testament also records God's sovereign act of cutting off nations before Israel to establish His people in their land, underscoring His authority over all peoples. Thus, while God welcomes all nations to honor Him, His people are called to remain faithful to His commands and not conform to worldly patterns.
